query: We just finished migrating the database schema and all tests pass on the new models. Before we cut the release tag, I want to make sure we document what worked and what surprised us during this migration so future schema changes go smoother.
Phase 2 is done — the auth refactor landed, CI is green, and QA signed off. Can you do a retrospective on what we learned? Especially around the token refresh race condition we hit.
Ok I think we're ready to ship this phase. Before we do, let's capture lessons from the past two weeks. The caching layer was way harder than expected and I don't want to repeat those mistakes.
What did we learn from the API versioning work? I remember we had issues with backwards compatibility in the v2 endpoints and some surprising behavior with content negotiation headers.

Let's wrap up the monitoring milestone. We added Prometheus metrics, Grafana dashboards, and alerting rules across 3 services. I want to extract reusable knowledge before the team forgets the details.
Done with this phase of the CLI rewrite. The flag parsing, subcommand routing, and help text generation are all working. Can you pull together what we should carry forward to phase 3?

We shipped the notification system last week and already found two production issues. Before starting the next sprint, help me capture what went wrong with the WebSocket reconnection logic and the message deduplication approach.

The performance optimization phase is complete — P99 latency dropped from 800ms to 120ms. Let's do a proper retrospective. I want to know which optimizations gave us the biggest wins and which were dead ends.

I'm reflecting on the test infrastructure work we just finished. We moved from Jest to Vitest, added snapshot testing, and set up contract tests. Capture lessons learned so we can share with the platform team.

We just wrapped the security hardening sprint. CSP headers, rate limiting, input sanitization — all deployed. Before moving on, let's document the gotchas we hit so the next team doing this doesn't waste time on the same CORS issues.
Can you help me write a new caching middleware for the Express server? It needs to handle ETags, Cache-Control headers, and cache invalidation when the underlying data changes.
I'm learning Rust and want to understand how lifetimes work. Can you explain the borrow checker rules with some examples that show common mistakes beginners make?
The tests in test/integration/auth.test.ts are failing with a timeout on the token refresh flow. Can you look at the test setup and figure out why the mock server isn't responding?
What did we change in the last commit? I want to review the diff before I push to the remote. Show me what files were modified and summarize the changes.
I learned that Redis SCAN is better than KEYS for production use. Can you update our cache layer in src/cache/redis-client.ts to use SCAN instead of KEYS for the pattern matching operations?
Help me set up a lessons directory structure for the project wiki. I need folders for architecture decisions, incident reports, and onboarding guides. Create the directory tree.
We need to ship this hotfix ASAP — the payment processing is broken in production. The Stripe webhook handler in src/webhooks/stripe.ts is returning 500 on invoice.paid events.
Can you review the pull request at #247? It adds a new GraphQL resolver for the user preferences endpoint. I want to make sure the input validation is correct before we merge.
I want to plan the next phase of development. We need to add multi-tenancy support, improve the search infrastructure, and migrate to a new deployment platform. Help me break this down.
The documentation for the REST API is out of date. Can you compare the route definitions in src/routes/ with the OpenAPI spec in docs/api.yaml and list the discrepancies?
